head: Your Stressy turns Apple Watch data into one energy number
dek: Your Stressy uses what your Apple Watch already measures to show one number, your reserve from 0 to 100%: sleep fills it, stress drains it. It was #27 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: Through the day it compares your heart with your own calm level every five minutes. It costs $4.99, by Ervo Labs, and needs iOS 26 and an Apple Watch.
where: iPhone with Apple Watch, App Store, $4.99
means: If your watch shows lots of health numbers, this sums them up as one daily reserve.
todo: You need an Apple Watch; find Your Stressy in the App Store.
thumb_words: ONE ENERGY NUMBER FROM YOUR WATCH
